nativeModel.identity: Native Booster enum member, named by the game UI template and matched to enum values by type-library alias length. Shared lengths stay candidate sets.
nativeModel.ownership: Boosters have no component or settings type; effects live on the records they reference.

acknowledgements.allow_unverified_effect: Required for every booster field. No booster edit is gameplay-proven yet; the native value is proven, but whether the game re-reads it for an active booster has not been tested.
acknowledgements.allow_shared: Required where the owning record is applied by game code with an open consumer scope.
